name: twilio-1.0.0
description: SMS and voice call delivery via Twilio — for alerts, HITL escalation, and critical notifications

tools.name: sms_send
tools.description: Send an SMS to Zeus (or a custom number) via Twilio. Use for urgent alerts, HITL responses, and escalation when Discord/Telegram are unreachable.

message.description: Text message to send. Max 1600 characters.

to.description: Phone number to send to in E.164 format (e.g. +13475551234). Defaults to ZEUS_PHONE_NUMBER env var.

tools.name: voice_call
tools.description: Initiate a voice call to Zeus via Twilio that speaks a message aloud. Use ONLY for critical escalation when Zeus has not acknowledged a high-priority request within the timeout period.

message.description: Message to speak when the call connects. Max 200 characters.

to.description: Phone number to call in E.164 format. Defaults to ZEUS_PHONE_NUMBER env var.
